column1: # One factor changed from baseline per row, so a difference is attributable.

column2: wider latent: ARI is scored by a 10-component mixture on a 10-d space, so give the mixture room to separate classes
tighter bottleneck: force the encoder to discard measurement noise, which may help transfer even if it costs reconstruction
stronger KL: a more heavily regularised latent should cluster more cleanly, the main lever on ARI
weaker KL: the opposite direction, to confirm 0.075 is not simply the low end of a monotone trend
heavier masking: a stronger self-supervision signal is the usual route to representations that survive a distribution shift
more encoder capacity, holding the bottleneck fixed
release the variance floor: it binds for 98% of samples, so it is shaping training whether or not we intended it
interaction of the two levers most likely to move ARI on their own
